SELECT c.Segment
FROM yearmonth y
JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY c.Segment
ORDER BY SUM(y.Consumption) ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS ym
    JOIN customers AS c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
min_totals AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
segment_avgs AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM totals AS t
    JOIN min_totals AS m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_LAM_diff,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_KAM_diff,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_SME_diff;

WITH annual AS (
    SELECT ym.CustomerID,
           c.Segment,
           SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM annual
    GROUP BY Segment
),
segment_avg AS (
    SELECT a.Segment,
           SUM(a.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_average
    FROM annual a
    JOIN lowest l ON a.Segment = l.Segment AND a.total_consumption = l.min_consumption
    GROUP BY a.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_average FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_average FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_average FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_average FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_average FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_average FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME

      FROM postHistory

      HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
  );

WITH comment_counts AS (
    SELECT UserId, COUNT(Id) AS cnt
    FROM comments
    WHERE UserId IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY UserId
),
top_users AS (
    SELECT UserId
    FROM comment_counts
    WHERE cnt = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM comment_counts)
)
SELECT u.Id AS UserId, u.DisplayName, b.Name AS Badge
FROM top_users t
JOIN users u ON u.Id = t.UserId
LEFT JOIN badges b ON b.UserId = u.Id
ORDER BY u.Id, b.Name;

WITH pc AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.country_id, p.player_api_id, p.weight
    FROM Match m
    JOIN Player p
      ON p.player_api_id IN (
           m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,
           m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
           m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5,
           m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
         )
),
avg_by_country AS (
    SELECT country_id, AVG(weight) AS avg_weight
    FROM pc
    GROUP BY country_id
)
SELECT c.name
FROM Country c
JOIN avg_by_country a ON a.country_id = c.id
WHERE a.avg_weight = (SELECT MAX(avg_weight) FROM avg_by_country);

        UNION ALL SELECT home_player_4, country_id FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT home_player_5, country_id FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT home_player_6, country_id FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT home_player_7, country_id FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT home_player_8, country_id FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT home_player_9, country_id FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT home_player_10, country_id FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT home_player_11, country_id FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT away_player_1, country_id FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT away_player_2, country_id FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT away_player_3, country_id FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT away_player_4, country_id FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT away_player_5, country_id FROM Match

WITH min2013 AS (
    SELECT c.segment, MIN(y.consumption) AS min_cons
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customer c ON y.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE c.currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.segment, y.customer_id
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customer c ON y.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN min2013 m ON c.segment = m.segment
    WHERE c.currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND y.consumption = m.min_cons
),
avg_seg AS (
    SELECT l.segment,
           SUM(y.consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT l.customer_id) AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest l
    JOIN yearmonth y ON y.customer_id = l.customer_id
    WHERE y.date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY l.segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE segment = 'KAM')

FROM account AS T1
JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id
JOIN loan AS T3 ON T1.account_id = T3.account_id

SELECT CASE WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995' ELSE '1996' END FROM district;

FROM account AS T1
JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
JOIN client AS T3 ON T2.client_id = T3.client_id
JOIN district AS T4 ON T3.district_id = T4.district_id
WHERE T3.gender = 'F'

  AND YEAR(a.opening_date) = 1993

      SELECT MAX(l2.approved_amount)

SELECT account.date

WHERE trans.amount = 840 AND trans.date = '1998-10-14';

WHERE account_id IN (

    FROM disp

    )
);

SELECT
  (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(c.client_id)
     FROM client c
    WHERE c.client_id IN (
        SELECT d.client_id
          FROM disp d
         WHERE d.account_id = account.account_id
           AND d.type = 'OWNER'

JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate

INNER JOIN account AS a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
INNER JOIN disp AS d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
INNER JOIN client AS c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M' AND strftime('%Y', l.date) IN ('1996', '1997');

WITH bond_elements AS (
    SELECT c.bond_id,
           CASE WHEN a1.element < a2.element THEN a1.element ELSE a2.element END AS elem1,
           CASE WHEN a1.element < a2.element THEN a2.element ELSE a1.element END AS elem2
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
),
combo_counts AS (
    SELECT elem1, elem2, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM bond_elements
    GROUP BY elem1, elem2
),
most_common AS (
    SELECT elem1, elem2
    FROM combo_counts
    WHERE cnt = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM combo_counts)
)
SELECT COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS percentage
FROM bond_elements be
JOIN most_common mc ON be.elem1 = mc.elem1 AND be.elem2 = mc.elem2

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN avgc END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avgc END) AS diff_SME_LAM,
  SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avgc END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN avgc END) AS diff_LAM_KAM,
  SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN avgc END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN avgc END) AS diff_KAM_SME
FROM (
  SELECT ct.Segment,
         SUM(ct.total) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT ct.CustomerID) AS avgc
  FROM (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment, ym.CustomerID AS CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
  ) ct
  JOIN (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS min_total
    FROM (
      SELECT c.Segment AS Segment, ym.CustomerID AS CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total
      FROM yearmonth ym
      JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
      WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
        AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
        AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
    ) m
    GROUP BY Segment
  ) mn ON ct.Segment = mn.Segment AND ct.total = mn.min_total
  GROUP BY ct.Segment
) avgs;

  SELECT loan.amount,
         CASE
           WHEN LENGTH(loan.date) = 6 THEN 1900 + CAST(SUBSTR(loan.date, 1, 2) AS INTEGER)
           ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(loan.date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)
         END AS yr
  FROM loan
  JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
  JOIN disp ON disp.account_id = account.account_id

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
minTotals AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS minTotal
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
averages AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total) * 1.0 / COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS annualAvg
    FROM totals t
    JOIN minTotals m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total = m.minTotal
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annualAvg FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annualAvg FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annualAvg FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annualAvg FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annualAvg FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annualAvg FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total_consumption) AS sum_total, COUNT(*) AS num_customers
    FROM czk_2013 t
    JOIN min_per_segment m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
),
avg_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, sum_total * 1.0 / num_customers AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME') -
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM') -
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

SELECT t.CustomerID, SUM(t.Price) / SUM(t.Amount) AS avg_price_per_item, c.Currency
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID

    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k

    ORDER BY SUM(Price) DESC
    LIMIT 1

SELECT dp.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district)
       - (SELECT MIN(ds.A11)
          FROM client c
          JOIN district ds ON c.district_id = ds.district_id
          WHERE c.gender = 'F'
            AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')) AS gap
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
  AND d.A11 = (SELECT MIN(ds2.A11)
               FROM client c2
               JOIN district ds2 ON c2.district_id = ds2.district_id
               WHERE c2.gender = 'F'
                 AND c2.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F'))

SELECT
  (SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) AS INTEGER) = 1997 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
   - SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) AS INTEGER) = 1996 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END))
   * 100.0
   / SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) AS INTEGER) = 1996 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
WHERE l.account_id IN (
      SELECT d.account_id
      FROM disp d
      JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
      WHERE c.gender = 'M')
  AND CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) AS INTEGER) IN (1996, 1997);

   JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID

  /
  (SELECT COUNT(T2.CustomerID) FROM customers AS T2 WHERE T2.Segment = 'SME' AND T2.Currency = 'CZK')
  -
  (SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption)
   FROM yearmonth AS T1
   JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T2.Segment = 'LAM' AND T2.Currency = 'CZK' AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312)

  (SELECT COUNT(T2.CustomerID) FROM customers AS T2 WHERE T2.Segment = 'LAM' AND T2.Currency = 'CZK') AS diff_SME_LAM,
  (SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption)
   FROM yearmonth AS T1
   JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T2.Segment = 'LAM' AND T2.Currency = 'CZK' AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312)
  /
  (SELECT COUNT(T2.CustomerID) FROM customers AS T2 WHERE T2.Segment = 'LAM' AND T2.Currency = 'CZK')
  -
  (SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption)
   FROM yearmonth AS T1
   JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T2.Segment = 'KAM' AND T2.Currency = 'CZK' AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312)
  /
  (SELECT COUNT(T2.CustomerID) FROM customers AS T2 WHERE T2.Segment = 'KAM' AND T2.Currency = 'CZK') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
  (SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption)

  (SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption)
   FROM yearmonth AS T1
   JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID

JOIN users ON comments.UserId = users.Id
WHERE users.DisplayName = 'Harvey Motulsky';

SELECT DISTINCT u.DisplayName
FROM comments c
JOIN users u ON c.UserId = u.Id
WHERE c.Score BETWEEN 1 AND 5
  AND u.DownVotes = 0;

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN u.UpVotes = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(c.UserId) AS percentage
FROM comments c
INNER JOIN users u ON c.UserId = u.Id
WHERE c.Score BETWEEN 5 AND 10;

SELECT c.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM'
  AND y.Date BETWEEN 201201 AND 201212
GROUP BY c.CustomerID
ORDER BY TotalConsumption ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(c.CustomerID)
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'KAM'
  AND y.Date BETWEEN 201201 AND 201212
  AND y.Consumption < 30000;

SELECT c.Segment
FROM yearmonth AS y
JOIN customers AS c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY c.Segment
ORDER BY SUM(y.Consumption) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    sme_avg.avg_consumption - lam_avg.avg_consumption AS diff_SME_LAM,
    lam_avg.avg_consumption - kam_avg.avg_consumption AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    kam_avg.avg_consumption - sme_avg.avg_consumption AS diff_KAM_SME
FROM
    (SELECT SUM(y.Consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID) AS avg_consumption
     FROM customers c
     JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
     WHERE c.Segment = 'SME' AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
       AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312) sme_avg
CROSS JOIN
    (SELECT SUM(y.Consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID) AS avg_consumption
     FROM customers c
     JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
     WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM' AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
       AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312) lam_avg
CROSS JOIN
    (SELECT SUM(y.Consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID) AS avg_consumption
     FROM customers c
     JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
     WHERE c.Segment = 'KAM' AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
       AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312) kam_avg;

SELECT c.CustomerID
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM'
  AND c.Currency = 'EUR'
  AND y.Date = '201310'
ORDER BY y.Consumption DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'KAM'
  AND y.Date = 201305;

SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ym.Consumption > 46.73 THEN ym.CustomerID END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID) AS percentage
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM';

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN c.CustomerID END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID) AS Percentage_KAM_Euro
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'KAM';

SELECT MAX(y.Consumption) AS HighestConsumption
FROM yearmonth y
JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012';

SELECT MAX(T.monthly_consumption) AS biggest_monthly_consumption
FROM (
    SELECT c.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) / 12 AS monthly_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID
) T;

SELECT DISTINCT p.Description
FROM yearmonth y
JOIN transactions_1k t ON y.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
WHERE y.Date = 201309;

SELECT DISTINCT g.Country
FROM gasstations g
JOIN transactions_1k t ON g.GasStationID = t.GasStationID
WHERE SUBSTR(t.Date, 1, 6) = '201306'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID)
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'

SELECT c.CustomerID, SUM(t.Price) AS TotalPaid
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25'
GROUP BY c.CustomerID
ORDER BY TotalPaid DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT g.Country
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25'
ORDER BY t.Time ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.Segment
FROM customers c
JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
ORDER BY t.Date, t.Time
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.Country
FROM transactions_1k AS T1
JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID
WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-24' AND T1.Time = '12:42:00';

SELECT c.Currency
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE y.Date = '201306' AND y.Consumption = 214582.17;

SELECT g.Country
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-24' AND t.Price = 548.4;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN t.CustomerID END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT t.CustomerID) AS percentage
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25';
SELECT SUM(t.Price) FROM transactions_1k t JOIN yearmonth y ON t.CustomerID = y.CustomerID WHERE t.CustomerID = 38508 AND y.Date = '201201';

SELECT c.CustomerID, SUM(t.Price) / SUM(t.Amount) AS avg_price_per_item, c.Currency
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Currency
ORDER BY SUM(t.Price) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT P.player_api_id, P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes);
SELECT T1.player_name, T1.height FROM Player AS T1 JOIN (SELECT MAX(height) AS max_height FROM Player) AS T2 ON T1.height = T2.max_height

SELECT p.player_api_id, p.player_name, MAX(pa.crossing) AS max_crossing
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY max_crossing DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Match AS M
JOIN Team AS T ON M.home_team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016'
  AND M.home_team_goal - M.away_team_goal < 0
GROUP BY T.team_long_name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.player_api_id
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE substr(T2.date, 1, 4) = '2010'
  AND T2.overall_rating = (
      SELECT MAX(overall_rating)
      FROM Player_Attributes
      WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'
  );

SELECT DISTINCT TA.team_fifa_api_id
FROM Team_Attributes TA
JOIN Team T ON TA.team_fifa_api_id = T.team_fifa_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlaySpeed > 50 AND TA.buildUpPlaySpeed < 60;

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', TA.date) = '2012'
  AND TA.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
  AND TA.buildUpPlayPassing > (
      SELECT SUM(TA2.buildUpPlayPassing) / COUNT(T2.team_long_name)
      FROM Team_Attributes AS TA2
      JOIN Team AS T2 ON TA2.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id
      WHERE strftime('%Y', TA2.date) = '2012'
        AND TA2.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT SUM(pa.long_shots) / COUNT(pa.player_fifa_api_id) AS average_long_shots
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Ahmed Samir Farag';

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE P.height > 180
GROUP BY P.player_name
ORDER BY SUM(PA.heading_accuracy) / COUNT(PA.player_fifa_api_id) DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
  AND TA.date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND TA.date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'
  AND TA.chanceCreationPassing < (
      SELECT AVG(TA2.chanceCreationPassing)
      FROM Team_Attributes AS TA2
      WHERE TA2.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
        AND TA2.date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
        AND TA2.date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'
  )
ORDER BY TA.chanceCreationPassing DESC;

SELECT PA.attacking_work_rate
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Franco Zennaro';

SELECT pa.heading_accuracy
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Francois Affolter'
  AND pa.date = '2014-09-18 00:00:00';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_matches
FROM Match
JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id
WHERE League.name = 'Scotland Premier League'
  AND Match.season = '2015/2016';

SELECT pa.preferred_foot
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.birthday = (SELECT MAX(birthday) FROM Player);
SELECT League.name FROM League JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id WHERE Country.name = 'Netherlands';

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Player WHERE strftime('%Y', birthday) = '1990';

FROM Player_Attributes PA

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_short_name

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player p

FROM Player P

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Slow';

FROM Country C
JOIN Match M ON C.id = M.country_id
JOIN Player P ON P.player_api_id IN (M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, M.home_player_5, M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11, M.away_player_1, M.away_player_2, M.away_player_3, M.away_player_4, M.away_player_5, M.away_player_6, M.away_player_7, M.away_player_8, M.away_player_9, M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11)
WHERE C.name = 'Italy';

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player AS P
WHERE P.height > 180
ORDER BY P.player_name ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.account_id)
FROM account AS T1
INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id
INNER JOIN loan AS T3 ON T1.account_id = T3.account_id
WHERE T2.A3 = 'Prague'
  AND T3.status IN ('A', 'C');
SELECT AVG(A12) AS avg_unemployment_1995, AVG(A13) AS avg_unemployment_1996, CASE WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995' ELSE '1996' END AS higher_year FROM district;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) AS num_districts
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND d.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND d.A11 > 8000;

SELECT a.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(d2.A11) FROM district d2) - (SELECT MIN(d2.A11) FROM district d2) AS gap
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC, d.A11 ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12
  AND substr(a.date, 1, 4) = '1993'
  AND l.amount = (
      SELECT MAX(l2.amount)
      FROM loan l2
      JOIN account a2 ON l2.account_id = a2.account_id
      WHERE l2.duration > 12
        AND substr(a2.date, 1, 4) = '1993'
  );

SELECT DISTINCT account.account_id
FROM account
JOIN trans ON account.account_id = trans.account_id
WHERE account.date < '1997-01-01'
  AND trans.balance > 3000;

SELECT account.date
FROM trans
JOIN account ON trans.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE trans.amount = 840
  AND trans.date = '1998-10-14';

SELECT MAX(t.amount) AS max_transaction_amount
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE c.issued = '1996-10-21';

SELECT COUNT(account.account_id)
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Litomerice'
  AND SUBSTR(account.date, 1, 2) = '96';

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id, a.frequency
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district dt ON c.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE dt.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND a.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '2000-12-31';

SELECT account.account_id, account.date
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Prachatice';

SELECT d.A3
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
ORDER BY l.amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.district_id AS branch_location, d.A2 AS district_name
FROM district d
JOIN (SELECT MAX(CAST(A13 AS DECIMAL)) AS max_rate FROM district) m
  ON CAST(d.A13 AS DECIMAL) = m.max_rate;

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A16 = (SELECT MAX(d2.A16) FROM district d2);

SELECT COUNT(l.loan_id) AS approved_loans
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND l.amount >= 250000
  AND l.status IN ('A', 'C')
  AND l.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.district_id = 1
  AND l.status IN ('C', 'D');

SELECT COUNT(c.client_id) AS male_clients
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND d.A15 = (
      SELECT A15
      FROM district
      ORDER BY A15 DESC
      LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
  );
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM card JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id WHERE card.type = 'gold' AND disp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT DISTINCT o.account_id
FROM "order" o
JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE o.k_symbol = 'SIPO'
  AND d.A2 = 'Pisek';

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
WHERE c.type = 'gold';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT account.account_id)
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
JOIN trans ON trans.account_id = account.account_id

         WHEN EXISTS (
             SELECT 1
             FROM molecule m
             WHERE m.label = '+'
               AND m.molecule_id IN (
                   SELECT b.molecule_id

                   WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
                   GROUP BY b.molecule_id

                       SELECT MAX(cnt)
                       FROM (
                           SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
                           FROM bond

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME','LAM','KAM')
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
mins AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS min_total
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_consumption
    FROM totals t
    JOIN mins m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total = m.min_total
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH pairs AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.bond_id,
           MIN(a1.element, a2.element) AS e1,
           MAX(a1.element, a2.element) AS e2
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
),
top_combo AS (
    SELECT e1, e2
    FROM pairs
    GROUP BY e1, e2
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pairs p JOIN top_combo t ON p.e1 = t.e1 AND p.e2 = t.e2)
             / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond);

WITH t AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, y.Consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
),
m AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(Consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM t
    GROUP BY Segment
),
low AS (
    SELECT t.Segment,
           SUM(t.Consumption) AS total_consumption,
           COUNT(DISTINCT t.CustomerID) AS num_customers
    FROM t
    JOIN m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.Consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
),
a AS (
    SELECT Segment, total_consumption * 1.0 / num_customers AS annual_avg
    FROM low
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM a WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM a WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM a WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM a WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.DNA < 8 AND T1.Description IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.GOT >= 60
SELECT Birthday FROM Patient WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE GOT >= 60) ORDER BY Birthday DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT MIN(P."First Date") FROM Patient AS P JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE L.LDH < 500 GROUP BY P.ID ORDER BY MAX(L.LDH) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5 ORDER BY ALB DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.ALB > 3.5 AND T2.ALB < 5.5 AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5
SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) FROM Examination AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5
SELECT T1.ID FROM Examination AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5 GROUP BY T1.ID ORDER BY MAX(T1.`aCL IgA`) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) FROM Laboratory AS L JOIN Examination AS E ON L.ID = E.ID WHERE L.`T-BIL` >= 2.0 AND E.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%'
SELECT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.TG < 200 ORDER BY T2.TG DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT bond_type FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type HAVING COUNT(bond_type) = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(bond_type) AS cnt FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type) AS t)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) FROM molecule m WHERE m.label = '-' AND m.molecule_id IN (SELECT a.molecule_id FROM atom a WHERE a.element = 'cl')

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN bond.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(connected.atom_id)

JOIN molecule ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(atom_id) AS percentage FROM atom WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '=')

SELECT DISTINCT a.element

SELECT DISTINCT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c

JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = a1.molecule_id

SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000' ORDER BY element ASC LIMIT 3;
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM molecule

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id FROM molecule JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '-' AND bond.bond_type = '-' ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id LIMIT 3
SELECT bond_id FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006' ORDER BY bond_id ASC LIMIT 2
SELECT T1.bond_type, T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2 FROM bond AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9'
SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label FROM atom a JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10'
SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR004'

SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected UNION SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected)
SELECT connected.atom_id, connected.atom_id2 FROM connected JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id WHERE bond.bond_type = '#' AND bond.molecule_id = 'TR041'
SELECT m.molecule_id FROM molecule m JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = ' = ' GROUP BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT c.atom_id2 FROM connected AS c JOIN atom AS a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id WHERE a.element = 'pb'

SELECT 100.0 * MAX(t.cnt) / (SELECT COUNT(bond_id) FROM bond) FROM (SELECT COUNT(c.bond_id) AS cnt FROM connected AS c JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element) AS t

SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(b.bond_id), 5) AS percentage
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.element) FROM atom JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = '-'
SELECT molecule_id, label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id IN ('TR000', 'TR001', 'TR002')

    JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
    WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
    UNION
    SELECT a.element
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'

SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2 FROM connected AS T1 JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T2.bond_type = '#'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id) FROM molecule INNER JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = '-' AND molecule.label = '-'

SELECT b.bond_id, CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic_status

SELECT CASE WHEN T1.label = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic' ELSE 'Non-carcinogenic' END FROM molecule AS T1 JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.element = 'ca'
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = ' = ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(bond_id) AS percent FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR047';
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR151' AND label = '+';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule WHERE label = '+');
SELECT T2.molecule_id FROM connected AS T1 JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T2.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2' AND T1.atom_id = 'TR000_1'
SELECT atom_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'c' AND molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule WHERE label = '-');
SELECT COUNT(bond.bond_id), molecule.label FROM bond JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = ' = ' AND molecule.molecule_id = 'TR006' GROUP BY molecule.label;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) FROM bond AS b JOIN connected AS c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2 WHERE a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'cl'
SELECT T2.atom_id, COUNT(DISTINCT T1.bond_type) FROM bond AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR346' GROUP BY T2.atom_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 's') AND molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = ' = ');
SELECT m.label FROM bond b JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4'
SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id FROM molecule JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'cl' AND molecule.label = '+'
SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id FROM atom a JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE a.element = 'c' AND m.label = '-';
SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_7'
SELECT T1.molecule_id FROM atom AS T1 JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND T2.atom_id = 'TR000_4'
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1'
SELECT CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' END FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000';
SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 's' AND molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = ' = ');
SELECT T1.molecule_id FROM molecule AS T1 JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.label = '+' GROUP BY T1.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(T2.atom_id) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) FROM atom a JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'o' AND b.bond_type = ' = ';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id) FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '#' AND T2.label = '-'

FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.SOCType = 'Continuation School'

FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.NumTstTakr > 500
  AND sc.Magnet = 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM satscores st
JOIN schools s ON st.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY st.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.CDSCode
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Enrollment (K-12)` + f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500;

FROM satscores t
JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'

LIMIT 1;

FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON sc.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499

FROM schools AS s
JOIN satscores AS t ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Riverside'

FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Monterey'

FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'

      FROM frpm f2
      JOIN schools s2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode

JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode

SELECT s.School

JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode

SELECT s.sname, sc.MailStreet

SELECT GSserved

SELECT f."District Code",

WITH cust_totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, c.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
min_totals AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM cust_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avg_per_segment AS (
    SELECT ct.Segment,
           SUM(ct.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(ct.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM cust_totals ct
    JOIN min_totals mt
      ON ct.Segment = mt.Segment AND ct.total_consumption = mt.min_consumption
    GROUP BY ct.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME')
        - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
        - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
        - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_patient_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outpatient_count,
    (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) /
     SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) * 100 AS percentage,
    (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) /
     SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) * 100 - 100 AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, (YEAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - YEAR(P.Birthday)) AS age
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.RVVT = '+';

FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis

JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID

SELECT MAX(CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) - MIN(CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age_gap

WHERE Laboratory.TG >= 200;

LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= '8.0' THEN l.ID END) * 1.0
     / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= '6.5' THEN l.ID END) AS male_female_ratio
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID;

SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS average_age

WITH base AS (
  SELECT c.Segment AS seg,
         y.CustomerID AS cid,
         y.Consumption AS cons
  FROM yearmonth AS y
  JOIN customers AS c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
    AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
),
minc AS (
  SELECT seg, MIN(cons) AS min_cons
  FROM base
  GROUP BY seg
),
avgs AS (
  SELECT b.seg AS seg,
         CAST(SUM(b.cons) AS REAL) / COUNT(b.cid) AS ann_avg
  FROM base AS b
  JOIN minc AS m ON m.seg = b.seg AND m.min_cons = b.cons
  GROUP BY b.seg
)
SELECT
  (SELECT ann_avg FROM avgs WHERE seg = 'SME') - (SELECT ann_avg FROM avgs WHERE seg = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
  (SELECT ann_avg FROM avgs WHERE seg = 'LAM') - (SELECT ann_avg FROM avgs WHERE seg = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
  (SELECT ann_avg FROM avgs WHERE seg = 'KAM') - (SELECT ann_avg FROM avgs WHERE seg = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

WITH yearly_totals AS (
    SELECT y.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total
    FROM yearmonth AS y
    JOIN customers AS c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY y.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_totals AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS min_total
    FROM yearly_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT yt.Segment, SUM(yt.total) AS total_consumption, COUNT(*) AS num_customers
    FROM yearly_totals AS yt
    JOIN min_totals AS mt
      ON yt.Segment = mt.Segment AND yt.total = mt.min_total
    GROUP BY yt.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT total_consumption / num_customers FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT total_consumption / num_customers FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT total_consumption / num_customers FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT total_consumption / num_customers FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT total_consumption / num_customers FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT total_consumption / num_customers FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH Yearly AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
MinPerSegment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM Yearly
    GROUP BY Segment
),
AnnualAvg AS (
    SELECT y.Segment,
           SUM(y.TotalConsumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(y.CustomerID) AS AnnualAverage
    FROM Yearly y
    JOIN MinPerSegment m
      ON y.Segment = m.Segment AND y.TotalConsumption = m.MinConsumption
    GROUP BY y.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM AnnualAvg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM AnnualAvg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS Diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM AnnualAvg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM AnnualAvg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS Diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM AnnualAvg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT AnnualAverage FROM AnnualAvg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS Diff_KAM_SME;

SELECT t.country_name AS name
FROM (
    SELECT c.name AS country_name, AVG(p.weight) AS avg_weight
    FROM Country c
    JOIN Match m ON m.country_id = c.id
    JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id IN (
        m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5, m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
        m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
    )
    GROUP BY c.name
) t
WHERE t.avg_weight = (
    SELECT MAX(t2.avg_weight)
    FROM (
        SELECT AVG(p2.weight) AS avg_weight
        FROM Country c2

WITH bond_elem AS (
    SELECT c.bond_id AS bond_id,
           c.atom_id AS atom_id,
           CASE WHEN a1.element <= a2.element THEN a1.element ELSE a2.element END AS elem_lo,
           CASE WHEN a1.element >= a2.element THEN a1.element ELSE a2.element END AS elem_hi
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
),
combo AS (
    SELECT elem_lo, elem_hi, COUNT(atom_id) AS pair_cnt
    FROM bond_elem
    GROUP BY elem_lo, elem_hi
),
top_combo AS (
    SELECT elem_lo, elem_hi
    FROM combo
    WHERE pair_cnt = (SELECT MAX(pair_cnt) FROM combo)
)
SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT be.bond_id) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS percentage

WITH avg_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        (SELECT SUM(ym.Consumption) / COUNT(DISTINCT ym.CustomerID)
           FROM yearmonth ym
          WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
            AND ym.CustomerID IN (SELECT c.CustomerID FROM customers c WHERE c.Segment = 'SME' AND c.Currency = 'CZK')) AS sme_avg,
        (SELECT SUM(ym.Consumption) / COUNT(DISTINCT ym.CustomerID)
           FROM yearmonth ym
          WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
            AND ym.CustomerID IN (SELECT c.CustomerID FROM customers c WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM' AND c.Currency = 'CZK')) AS lam_avg,
        (SELECT SUM(ym.Consumption) / COUNT(DISTINCT ym.CustomerID)
           FROM yearmonth ym
          WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
            AND ym.CustomerID IN (SELECT c.CustomerID FROM customers c WHERE c.Segment = 'KAM' AND c.Currency = 'CZK')) AS kam_avg
)
SELECT
    sme_avg - lam_avg AS diff_SME_LAM,
    lam_avg - kam_avg AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    kam_avg - sme_avg AS diff_KAM_SME
FROM avg_consumption;

JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
WHERE t.team_short_name = 'CLB';

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_short_name
FROM Team_Attributes TA
JOIN Team T ON TA.team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlayPassing > 70;

SELECT Country.name
FROM League
JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id
WHERE League.name = 'Italy Serie A';

SELECT COUNT(M.id)
FROM Match M
JOIN League L ON M.league_id = L.id
WHERE L.name = 'Germany 1. Bundesliga'
  AND strftime('%Y-%m', M.date) BETWEEN '2008-08' AND '2008-10';

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player_Attributes PA
JOIN Player P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
ORDER BY PA.overall_rating DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.player_name, pa.crossing
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name IN ('Alexis', 'Ariel Borysiuk', 'Arouna Kone')
ORDER BY pa.crossing DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(M.id)
FROM Match M
JOIN League L ON M.league_id = L.id
WHERE L.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League'
  AND SUBSTR(M.date, 1, 7) = '2009-04';

SELECT L.name
FROM Match M
JOIN League L ON M.league_id = L.id
WHERE M.season = '2008/2009'
GROUP BY L.name
ORDER BY COUNT(M.id) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT SUM(T1.overall_rating) / COUNT(T1.id) FROM Player_Attributes AS T1 JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE strftime('%Y', T2.birthday) < '1986'

SELECT DISTINCT pa.preferred_foot
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo';

SELECT MAX(T1.overall_rating) AS highest_overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.player_name = 'Dorlan Pabon';

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player_Attributes PA
JOIN Player P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
WHERE PA.overall_rating = 77
  AND PA.date LIKE '2016-06-23%'
ORDER BY P.birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT pa.attacking_work_rate
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Francesco Migliore'
  AND pa.date LIKE '2015-05-01%';

SELECT PA.defensive_work_rate
FROM Player_Attributes PA
JOIN Player P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Kevin Berigaud'
  AND PA.date = '2013-02-22 00:00:00';

SELECT AVG(PA.overall_rating) AS average_overall_rating
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic'
  AND SUBSTR(PA.date, 1, 10) BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2016-04-21';

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player P
LEFT JOIN Player P2 ON P2.height > P.height
WHERE P2.id IS NULL;

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Match AS M
  ON P.player_api_id IN (
       M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, M.home_player_5,
       M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11,
       M.away_player_1, M.away_player_2, M.away_player_3, M.away_player_4, M.away_player_5,
       M.away_player_6, M.away_player_7, M.away_player_8, M.away_player_9, M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11
     )
JOIN Country AS C ON M.country_id = C.id
WHERE C.name = 'Belgium';

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name, c.name AS country
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
JOIN Match m ON pa.player_api_id IN (
        m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,
        m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
        m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5,
        m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
    )
JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id
WHERE pa.vision > 89;

SELECT c.name AS country, AVG(p.weight) AS avg_weight
FROM Player p
JOIN Match m ON p.player_api_id IN (m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5, m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11, m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11)
JOIN Country c ON c.id = m.country_id
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY AVG(p.weight) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT t.team_long_name
FROM Team t
JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
WHERE ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Slow';

SELECT AVG(DISTINCT P.height)
FROM Player P
JOIN Match M
  ON P.player_api_id IN (M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, M.home_player_5, M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11,
                         M.away_player_1, M.away_player_2, M.away_player_3, M.away_player_4, M.away_player_5, M.away_player_6, M.away_player_7, M.away_player_8, M.away_player_9, M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11)
JOIN Country C
  ON C.id = M.country_id
WHERE C.name = 'Italy';

SELECT player_name
FROM Player
WHERE height > 180
ORDER BY player_name
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague' AND l.loan_id IS NULL;

SELECT AVG(d.A12) AS avg_unemployment_1995,
       AVG(d.A13) AS avg_unemployment_1996,
       CASE WHEN AVG(d.A12) > AVG(d.A13) THEN '1995' ELSE '1996' END AS year_with_higher_rate
FROM district d;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) AS num_districts
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_customers
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND d.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND d.A11 > 8000;

SELECT T4.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - T2.A11 AS gap
FROM client AS T1
JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id
JOIN disp AS T3 ON T1.client_id = T3.client_id
JOIN account AS T4 ON T3.account_id = T4.account_id
WHERE T1.gender = 'F'
ORDER BY T1.birth_date ASC, T2.A11 ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.account_id
FROM account AS T1
INNER JOIN loan AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T2.duration > 12
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.date) = '1993'
ORDER BY T2.amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE a.date < '1997-01-01'
  AND l.amount > 3000;

SELECT account.date
FROM trans
JOIN account ON trans.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE trans.amount = 840
  AND trans.date = '1998-10-14';

SELECT MAX(t.amount) AS max_transaction_amount
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE c.issued = '1996-10-21';

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Litomerice'
  AND a.date LIKE '96%';

SELECT c.client_id, a.account_id, a.frequency
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district dt ON c.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE dt.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND a.date >= '1995-01-01'
  AND a.date < '2001-01-01'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT account.account_id, account.date
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Prachatice';

SELECT d.A3
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
ORDER BY l.amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT d1.A3 AS branch_location, d1.A2 AS district_name
FROM district d1
LEFT JOIN district d2
    ON CAST(d1.A13 AS REAL) < CAST(d2.A13 AS REAL)
WHERE d2.district_id IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
GROUP BY d.district_id
ORDER BY d.A16 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(l.loan_id)
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND l.amount >= 250000
  AND l.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
  AND l.status IN ('A', 'C');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE a.district_id = 1
  AND l.status IN ('C', 'D');

SELECT COUNT(c.client_id) AS male_clients
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND d.A15 = (SELECT A15 FROM district ORDER BY A15 DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1);
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM card JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id WHERE card.type = 'gold' AND disp.type = 'OWNER'

SELECT DISTINCT o.account_id
FROM `order` o
JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE o.k_symbol = 'SIPO'
  AND d.A2 = 'Pisek';

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
WHERE c.type = 'gold';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND t.bank = 'AB';

SELECT COUNT(c.client_id) AS num_male_clients
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Hl.m. Praha' AND c.gender = 'M';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'gold' AND issued < '1998-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percent_gold_before_1998
FROM card;

SELECT card.type
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
WHERE client.client_id = 13539;

SELECT d.A3
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.client_id = 3541;

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN c.client_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS percentage_women
FROM client c
JOIN disp ON disp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE d.A11 > 10000;

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
        - SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END))
       * 100.0
       / SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN d.A3 = 'north Bohemia' THEN d.A16 ELSE 0 END) 
     - SUM(CASE WHEN d.A3 = 'east Bohemia' THEN d.A16 ELSE 0 END) AS crime_difference
FROM district d
WHERE d.A3 IN ('north Bohemia', 'east Bohemia');

SELECT strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS birth_year
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER' AND c.client_id = 130;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU';

SELECT l.loan_id,
       l.amount AS debt_amount,
       l.status AS payment_status,
       l.payments AS monthly_payment,
       l.duration
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE c.client_id = 992
  AND l.status IN ('B', 'D');

SELECT SUM(t.amount) AS total_paid
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE c.client_id = 617
  AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND (t.date LIKE '1998%' OR t.date LIKE '98%');

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Beroun' AND a.date > '1996-12-31';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM loan 
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id 
WHERE loan.duration = 24 
  AND account.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE';

SELECT c.client_id,
       (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date)) AS age
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
JOIN client c ON disp.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE card.type = 'gold'
  AND disp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT COUNT(member.member_id)
FROM member
INNER JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE major.college = 'College of Engineering';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member.member_id) AS num_students
FROM attendance
JOIN event ON attendance.link_to_event = event.event_id
JOIN member ON attendance.link_to_member = member.member_id
WHERE event.event_name = "Women's Soccer";

SELECT m.phone
FROM attendance a
JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer'

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
ORDER BY COUNT(a.link_to_member) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T3.event_id)
FROM member AS T1
JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member
JOIN event AS T3 ON T2.link_to_event = T3.event_id
WHERE T1.first_name = 'Sacha'
  AND T1.last_name = 'Harrison'
  AND YEAR(T3.event_date) = 2019

SELECT COUNT(*) AS meeting_count
FROM (
    SELECT e.event_id
    FROM event e
    JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
    WHERE e.type = 'Meeting'
    GROUP BY e.event_id
    HAVING COUNT(a.link_to_member) > 10
) AS qualified_events;

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
WHERE e.type != 'Fundraiser'
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
HAVING COUNT(a.link_to_event) > 20;

SELECT COUNT(a.link_to_member) / COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_name) AS average_attendance
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.type = 'Meeting'
  AND YEAR(e.event_date) = 2020;

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN attendance a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'Laugh Out Loud';

SELECT SUM(b.spent) AS total_food_spent
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'September Meeting'
  AND b.category = 'Food';

SELECT z.city, z.state
FROM member m
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE m.position = 'President';

SELECT income.notes
FROM income
WHERE income.source = 'Fundraising'
  AND income.date_received = '2019-09-14';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS exceeded_budget_count
FROM budget
JOIN event ON budget.link_to_event = event.event_id
WHERE event.event_name = 'November Meeting'
  AND budget.remaining < 0;

SELECT SUM(b.amount) AS total_budget_amount
FROM event e
JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
WHERE e.event_name = 'September Speaker';

SELECT COUNT(member.member_id)
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE major.major_name = 'Business'
  AND member.t_shirt_size = 'Medium';

SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name
FROM member AS T1
JOIN income AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member
WHERE T2.source = 'Dues'
ORDER BY T2.date_received ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN b.category = 'Parking' THEN b.amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(b.amount) AS percentage
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'November Speaker';
SELECT SUM(cost) FROM expense WHERE expense_description = 'Pizza';

SELECT z.city, z.county, z.state
FROM member m
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE m.first_name = 'Amy' AND m.last_name = 'Firth';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS maryland_hometown_members
FROM member m
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE z.state = 'Maryland';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS meeting_count
FROM event
WHERE type = 'Meeting'
  AND YEAR(event_date) = 2020;

SELECT DISTINCT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN expense e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
WHERE ev.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff';

SELECT m.t_shirt_size
FROM member m
GROUP BY m.t_shirt_size
ORDER BY COUNT(m.t_shirt_size) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT event.event_name
FROM event
JOIN budget ON event.event_id = budget.link_to_event
WHERE event.status = 'Closed'
  AND budget.remaining < 0
GROUP BY event.event_name
ORDER BY MIN(budget.remaining) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT b.category, SUM(b.amount) AS amount_budgeted
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'April Speaker'
GROUP BY b.category
ORDER BY amount_budgeted ASC;

SELECT budget_id, category, amount
FROM budget
WHERE category = 'Food'
ORDER BY amount DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT SUM(cost) FROM expense WHERE expense_description = 'Parking'
SELECT SUM(cost) FROM expense WHERE expense_date = '2019-08-20'

SELECT m.major_name
FROM member mem
JOIN major m ON mem.link_to_major = m.major_id
WHERE mem.first_name = 'Phillip' AND mem.last_name = 'Cullen';

SELECT m.position
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE mj.major_name = 'Business';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_members
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE major.major_name = 'Business'
  AND member.t_shirt_size = 'Medium';
SELECT type FROM event WHERE event_date = '2020-03-24T12:00:00';

SELECT major.major_name
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE member.position = 'Vice President';
SELECT COUNT(income_id) FROM income WHERE amount = 50

SELECT COUNT(major_id) AS major_count
FROM major
WHERE college = 'College of Agriculture and Applied Sciences'
  AND department = 'School of Applied Sciences, Technology and Education';

SELECT DISTINCT z.city, z.state
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE mj.department = 'Electrical and Computer Engineering Department'
  AND m.position = 'Member';

SELECT DISTINCT m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN attendance a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE m.position = 'Member'
  AND e.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer';
SELECT event_name FROM event WHERE type = 'Game' AND status = 'Closed' AND event_date BETWEEN '2019-03-15' AND '2020-03-20'

SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name, a.link_to_event
FROM expense e
JOIN member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN attendance a ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE e.approved = 'true'
  AND e.expense_date BETWEEN '2019-01-10' AND '2019-11-19';

SELECT DISTINCT member.email
FROM expense
JOIN member ON expense.link_to_member = member.member_id
WHERE expense.cost > 20
  AND expense.expense_date BETWEEN '2019-09-10' AND '2019-11-19';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM member 
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id 
WHERE major.major_name = 'Education' 
  AND major.college = 'College of Education & Human Services' 
  AND member.position = 'Member';

SELECT expense_description
FROM expense
GROUP BY expense_description
HAVING SUM(cost) / COUNT(expense_id) > 50;

SELECT SUM(e.cost) / COUNT(ev.event_id) AS average_amount_paid
FROM expense e
JOIN member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
WHERE m.position != 'Member';

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member AS m
JOIN expense AS e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name
ORDER BY MAX(e.cost) DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT DISTINCT m.first_name, m.last_name, m.phone
FROM member m
JOIN expense e ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE e.cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expense);

SELECT major.major_name, major.department
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE member.first_name = 'Garrett' AND member.last_name = 'Gerke';

SELECT m.last_name, m.phone
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE mj.major_name = 'Elementary Education';

SELECT member.first_name, member.last_name, major.college
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE member.position = 'Secretary';

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.spent) AS total_spent
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE b.category = 'Speaker Gifts'
GROUP BY e.event_name;

SELECT z.city
FROM member m
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE m.first_name = 'Garrett' AND m.last_name = 'Gerke';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
GROUP BY s.id, s.full_name
HAVING COUNT(hp.power_id) > 15;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_superheroes
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Blue';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s

SELECT CASE
         WHEN EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM molecule m
              WHERE m.label = '+'
                AND m.molecule_id IN (
                    SELECT b.molecule_id
                    FROM bond b
                    WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
                    GROUP BY b.molecule_id
                    HAVING COUNT(*) = (
                        SELECT MAX(t.cnt)
                        FROM (
                            SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
                            FROM bond
                            WHERE bond_type = ' = '
                            GROUP BY molecule_id
                        ) AS t
                    )
                )
         )
         THEN 'yes'
         ELSE 'no'
       END AS is_carcinogenic;

JOIN atom AS a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id 
WHERE a.element = 'cl';

SELECT T1.atom_id, COUNT(T3.bond_type) AS bond_type_count
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR346'
GROUP BY T1.atom_id;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
LEFT JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND a.element = 's'
LEFT JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = ' = '
WHERE a.atom_id IS NULL AND b.bond_id IS NULL;

SELECT m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl'
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_1_7';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM atom a1
JOIN atom a2 ON a1.molecule_id = a2.molecule_id
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = a1.molecule_id
WHERE a1.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND a2.atom_id = 'TR000_4';

SELECT atom.element
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 's' AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(a.atom_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id)
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 'o' AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS non_carcinogenic_triple_bond_count
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
  AND m.label = '-';
